hero.description: Health Nutrition helps you record meals, water, activity, and weight in one place. It makes it easier to understand your daily habits and see what you may need to adjust.
hero.secondary: Built for people who want to lose weight, gain weight, maintain their shape, or simply build healthier everyday habits.

features.title: Everything you need to keep track of your health
features.description: The website is designed to make daily tracking simple, easy to review, and easy to understand.

onboarding.title: Personal health profile
onboarding.description: Save your height, weight, calorie goal, water goal, and activity level so the experience fits you better.

meals.title: Meal diary
meals.description: Record breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks; quickly review calories, protein, carbs, and fat for the day.

database.title: Food library
database.description: Search common foods, check estimated calories, and add a new food when it is not already available.

activity.title: Activity tracking
activity.description: Record workouts, exercise time, and estimated calories burned during the day.

metrics.title: Body metrics
metrics.description: Track weight, BMI, waist measurements, and health notes so you can see changes over time.

statistics.title: Weekly and monthly reports
statistics.description: Review calorie, nutrition, activity, and goal progress across clear time periods.

flow.title: Start tracking your health in a few steps
flow.description: Create an account, enter your basic health information, then record meals and activity each day. The website brings everything together so it is easier to follow your progress.

auth.title: Register or log in
auth.description: Create an account with your email and password to save your personal information.

profile.title: Update your profile
profile.description: Enter height, weight, gender, activity level, and personal goals.

log.title: Record meals and activity
log.description: Add foods, water intake, and workouts completed during the day.

track.title: Review progress
track.description: Use the overview, weekly/monthly reports, and body metrics to understand your progress.

security.authDescription: Your personal information is connected to your own account. If you are not signed in, the website asks you to log in before viewing personal pages.
security.apiDescription: Meals, activity, water intake, and body metrics are kept in separate sections so you can review and manage them easily.

cta.title: Track health day by day, not by guesswork
cta.description: Start with your personal profile, record meals and activity, then use reports to adjust calorie, hydration, and weight goals.

dashboard.title: Health Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Track body metrics, macro ratio and calorie balance for the week.

foodDiary.title: Nutrition Diary
foodDiary.subtitle: Track foods, portions and calories by meal throughout the day.

goalFormulas.loseWeight: Weight loss: daily calories = TDEE - 500 kcal. Protein is kept high to reduce muscle loss.
goalFormulas.maintain: Maintain: daily calories = TDEE. Macros are balanced for stable weight.
goalFormulas.gainWeight: Gain weight: daily calories = TDEE + 400 kcal. Suitable when the goal is to increase body weight.
goalFormulas.gainMuscle: Gain muscle: daily calories = TDEE + 250 kcal with high protein.
goalFormulas.cutting: Cutting: daily calories = TDEE - 300 kcal with high protein to preserve muscle.
goalFormulas.bodyRecomposition: Body recomposition: daily calories stay near TDEE with very high protein.
goalFormulas.improveHealth: Improve fitness: daily calories stay near TDEE with balanced macros.
